= Notes and References (left to right)=

Note: Inclusion in the infographic does not indicate importance. There are some obscure characters picked out because of their unusual height or because they fit the scene. 

Equally, some more important characters never have their height described, even in the Companion, and so do not appear. Most heights are taken from the Wheel of Time Companion (C). (BWB) is The World of Robert Jordan's Wheel of Time. Some are referenced only in the books and are less exact.

Those marked * are estimates only. See the additional note for that creature/character.

Those marked + have no listed height and are non-canon.

RAKEN: Wingspan 90-100 feet (C)

TO'RAKEN: Wingspan 120+ feet (C)

DRAGKHAR+: 6'3" height. Wingspan >17'. A dragkhar is the size of a "large man" (C) and "overly tall" (BWB), but also with "very thin" and "frail" arms and a "gaunt" face.

The overall impression is a tall man that is emaciated so as to make the body light enough for flight. We scale bat wings to this size of body to estimate the wingspan, but bats are extremely lightweight, so the wingspan may be much greater.

JUMARA: At least 100 feet long (River of Souls)

ALDIEB+ and MANDARB+: Horses are measured in hands from feet to the withers (shoulder) with 16 hands being tall for a horse. 

Mandarb is taller than Aldieb, but no exact heights are known. We set Mandarb as 16 hands (5'4") and Aldieb as 15 (5'0").

MOIRAINE: 5'2" (C)

NYNAEVE: 5'4" (C)

(GOLDEN CRANE+): Wingspan of the common crane is 71–94 in (5'11"-7'10") with height 3'7"-4'6".

LAN: 6'5" (C)

MYRELLE: 5'4" (C)

TAKIMA: 5'1" (C)

LELAINE: 5'4" (C)

GAWYN: 6'3" (C)

VERIN: 5'0" (C)

EGWENE: 5'3" (C)

SILVIANA: 5'6.5" (C)

SIUAN: 5'5" (C)

ROMANDA: 5'4" (C)

VARILIN: 6'2" (C) Tallest known Aes Sedai

ESCARALDE: 4'10" (C) Shortest known Aes Sedai.

GAIDAL CAIN (REBORN): Just a baby...

BIRGITTE: 5'6" (C)

AVIENDHA: 5'9" (C) Remember to subtract two feet from this.

VANDENE: 5'5" (C)

ELAYNE: 5'7" (C)

CAREANE: 5'5" (C)

MERILILLE: 5'1" (C)

TALAAN: 5'5" (C)

ALUDRA: 5'5" (C)

VANIN: 5'10" (C)

(BADGER*): 1'0" 

MAT: 5'11" (C)

TUON: 4'11" (C)

TESLYN: 5'5" (C)

OLVER*: 4'0" Estimated as slightly below average for a 10 year old boy. He is Cairhienin and they are usually shorter.

JOLINE: 5'4" (C)

THOM: 6'0" (C)

JUILIN: 5'10" (C)

BERELAIN: 5'7" (C)

ANNOURA: 5'4" (C)

BALWER: 5'6" (C) Possibly the shortest man in the series.

PERRIN: 6'1" (C)

(HAWK* AND FALCON*): Wingspan for a red hawk is 3'7"-4'8" and 2'5"-3'11" for a peregrine falcon. 

Lengths are 1'6"-2'2" and 1'1-1'11" respectively. 

For both, the female is 25-30% larger than the male.

HOPPER+: Height of a wolf to shoulder is approximately 2'9".

ELYAS: 5'10" (C)

TAM: 5'10" (C)

FAILE: 5'7" (C)

ROLAN: 6'8" (C) Second tallest man after Bael. Perrin thought he was the "biggest Aiel he'd ever seen".

SELANDE: 5'3" (C)

SAMITSU: 5'5" (C)

DAIGIAN: 5'2" (C)

CADSUANE: 5'5" (C)

MIN: 5'5" (C)

RAND: 6'6" (C) Although he is also listed as 6'5". We choose the taller.

ASMODEAN*: He is a "taller than most" men, so somewhere above 6'0".

DAVRAM: 5'7" (C)

DEIRA: 5'10" (C) Notably 3" taller than her husband. Also quite tall for any female who is not Aiel.

TAIM: 6'4" (C)

COIREN: 5'5.5" (C) 

ERIAN: 5'5" (C)

GALINA: 5'5" (C)

FAIN+: 5'8". Ordieth/Fain described as "a bony little man" (TDR, Prologue, tFoH, Prologue) and, as Mordeth, an "odious little man". 

We pick some height that is below average for him..

ELAIDA: 5'6" (C)

ALVIARIN: 5'4" (C)

KATERINE: 5'6" (C)

MESAANA/DANELLE: 5'5" (C)

GROLM: Around 5'3" at shoulder. Described as about the size of big bear. (TGH, Ch. 16, BWB). 

CORLM: 6'0"-8'0". "Six feet or more" (C). "As much as 8 feet tall." (BWB).

EGEANIN: 5'7" (C)

BAYLE: 5'10" (C)

LOPAR: < 10'0" (C, BWB). Up to ten feel while standing. The estimate for all fours of 7'0" was made by moving the base model.

MOGHEDIEN: 5'5" (C)

MYLEN: 4'10" (C) Shortest Aes Sedai, now damane.

TYLIN'S HEAD: 1'0", probably. 5'3" when properly attached (C).

SEMIRHAGE/ANATH: 6'1.5" (C) 

ELZA: 5'5" (C)

SUROTH: 5'5" (C)

LIANDRIN: 5'5" (C)

TORM: c5'2" (C). Described as a "horse-sized cat". We use the equivalent of 15.5 hands at shoulder.

DEMANDRED/BAO: 6'4" (C)

S'REDIT*: 10'5" at shoulder. We use an African elephant as comparison, but may be smaller. 

Elayne says the adults are as tall as their coach (tFoH, Ch. 13).

DASHIVA+: No height given for Aginor or Dashiva. Dashiva is described as pretty average, so we assign him average heihght for the sake of completion.

GRAENDAL: c5'3" (aCoS, Ch. 20). As Maisa, she appears no more than up to Caddar's (Sammael) chest. 

Caddar is a hand taller than Modarra, which puts him at 6'6" using Mask of Mirrors. 

Presuming Graendal did not alter her height too, she's around 5'3".

SAMMAEL: 6'0" (C). Not that short, but shorter than every other male Forsaken we know the height for!

RAHVIN*: 6'8". "Taller than Rand with shoulders nearly the width of Perrins." (C)

BE'LAL+: 6'1". Only described as "tall" (TDR, Ch. 55). We put him a little above a myrdraal, who have a similar description.

MYRDRAAL: At least 6'0" (C). "The height of a fairly tall man, over six feet."

DARKHOUND: The size of a pony. A pony is a horse smaller than 14 or 14.2 hands (4'8" or 4'10"). See ALDIEB for horse measurements. 

SHAIDAR HARAN: 7'6". "Head and shoulders above a normal myrdraal". May be taller, but probably not significantly so.

LANFEAR: 5'11" (C)

ISHAMAEL*: No height given other than "not as tall" as Lews Therin (6'6") (tEotW, Prologue). 

In his new incarnation, Moridin is 6'5" or 6'6" similar to Rand (C).

TROLLOC: Between 8'0" and 10'0" (C)

(OGIER AXE): 10'5". The same length as Haman is tall (KoD, Ch. 19).

ENAILA: 5'2" (C). The shortest Aiel. And not happy about it.

COVRIL: 9'0" (C)

SOMERYN: "At least" 6'4" (C). The tallest woman in the series.

SEVANNA: 5'8" (C)

ERITH: 8'0" (C)

BAEL: 6'10" (C). The tallest man in the series.

CHIAD: 5'7.5" (C)

LOIAL: 10'0" (C) 

GAUL: 6'7" (C)

BAIN: 5'8.5" (C)

HAMAN: 10'5" (C)

THE GREEN MAN/SOMESHTA: 13'6". "As much bigger than Loial as the Ogier was bigger than

Rand" (tEotW, Ch. 49). There is 3'6" between Rand and Loial and Loial is 10'.

(DHURRAN):See notes for ALDIEB for horse measurements. We put these around the height of Clydesdale horses (18 hands or 6'0"). The largest known horse was measured at 21.25 hands with anything over 20 hands being exceptionally huge. They are described as very large, but the size of a pony in comparison to an Ogier.

BELA: Quite arbitrarily, we made Bela the same size as ALDIEB.
